listing.description:
# KittenExtensions Continued

This is a continuation of tom_is_unlucky's awesome KittenExtensions mod. All of the credit goes to him. It replaces the original mod under the new KittenExtensionsContinued mod and directory name while keeping the KittenExtensions assembly name for compatibility.

    Write XML patches to alter xml assets from core or other mods
    Add custom xml asset types that can be used in other mods

Visit the Forum Thread and Github Repo for more information.
